name: Persona 3: Dancing in Moonlight - Shinjiro Aragaki in "Battle Hymn of the Soul"
summary: Additional playable track 'Battle Hymn of the Soul' with Shinjiro Aragaki as main dancer. His costumes 'Winter Clothes', 'Two-Tone Bermuda Shorts', 'SEES Equipment', 'Butler Suit' and 'Deep Blue Clothes' are included. This item is compatible with both Persona 3: Dancing in Moonlight and Persona 5: Dancing in Starlight on PS4.
